implementation_state: Designed, not implemented. A separate, independent provider for OpenCode's authenticated Console tier at https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1 - not a prerequisite of the free provider and not depending on it. Credential is device-code OAuth (POST {console}/auth/device/code then /auth/device/token, client_id opencode-cli) yielding an access token, a refresh token and an org id sent back as x-opencode-org-id. The token refresh discipline (single-flight lock, generation guard, rotating credential) follows the existing account/adapters/newapi.rs pattern; token persistence location is an open decision (keychain vs private file). Discovery is GET {server}/api/config -> config.provider.*.models. It shares the same 'opencode' shaping identity as the free provider and reuses the OpenAI Chat Completions egress. Serves main traffic only, like the free provider.
required_gates: Device-code start/poll/refresh succeeds and persists a usable token
Rotating access token refreshed with single-flight discipline on 401/expiry
x-opencode-org-id attached from the resolved org
unblock_condition: Not blocked; design complete and ready for implementation.
notes: Independent of OPENCODE-ZEN-FREE: neither is the other's prerequisite.
Open item: whether the authenticated Console tier also requires the free-tier shape gate; if it does not, side queries could run over this provider unshaped.
